text:
Sam (Product): Quick quarterly milecheck — can each owner post what shipped vs slipped for their OKR milestones, plus any blockers and next steps? Please update by EOD. cc @Jia @Priya :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Jia (Eng): Shipped: compact batching rollout to prod for /generate. Perf numbers look good (+18% throughput).

Priya (PM): Slipped: model quantization experiments (Q) — needs more evals. Root cause: eval harness gaps + infra slot shortages.

Liam (Infra): Infra blocker: Dedicated pool GPU quota short by 2 nodes in us-west. Raised ticket to cloud team. ETA for extra quota = 48h.

Ruth (SRE): Noted increased OOMs on long-sequence jobs after batching bump. Temporary mitigation: lower max batch size for seq>2k. Will monitor.

Jia (Eng): @Liam can you review PR #4523? small perf tweak to KV cache handling, should reduce mem spikes. Link: https://git.redwood/eng/pull/4523 :eyes:

Liam (Infra): On it, aiming to review by EOD. If urgent, flag and I can prioritize.

Priya (PM): Owners check:
- Compact batching rollout = Jia (Eng) -> shipped
- Quantization evals = Priya (PM) + Jia -> slipped (needs infra)
- Dedicated node add = Liam -> blocked (cloud quota)

Sam (Product): Ok — can each owner add a 1-line next step and ETA? Also note any CRs needing review.

Jia (Eng): Next step: merge #4523, run 24h perf soak on prod canary. ETA: 24h. CR: @Liam.

Priya (PM): Next step: expand eval harness to cover low-latency regression tests. ETA: 5d. Will post task.

Liam (Infra): Next step: escalate quota ticket to account ops + request temporary burst capacity. ETA: initial reply in 6h.

Ruth (SRE): I'll apply the batch-size guard in prod pipeline tonight as hotfix. ETA: 2h.

deploy-bot: canary deployed to staging: canary-2026-03-05-17:20. Logs: /deploys/canary-2026-03-05-17:20

Sam (Product): Thanks. Action items summary: 
- Jia: merge #4523, run soak (24h) -> report perf metrics (+owners pinged for CR)
- Priya: own quant eval expansion (5d) -> coordinate with Jia & Liam for infra needs
- Liam: quota escalation + temp burst request (6h)
- Ruth: batch-size guard hotfix (2h)

Sam (Product): If any item looks like it will impact the quarterly OKR deliverable, flag for a short sync tomorrow. Otherwise we'll treat slips as next-sprint carryover and update the roadmap. :thumbsup:

Jia (Eng): I own follow-ups, will post a short status message after soak completes.

Priya (PM): I'll file the eval task and add acceptance criteria.

Liam (Infra): Ping me if you need me to join a sync with cloud ops.

Ruth (SRE): Hotfix applied, monitoring now. No regressions seen yet.

Sam (Product): Great — closing the async check. Thanks all. :rocket:
